column4: Your suit's motor systems are online. Step into the monitor room down the corridor for your briefing before launch.
It is a drifting twin structure, and the energy lies inside it. You will cross its hull, its server halls and its core.
I will mark in green, in your scans, what you can interact with. The hangar terminal is unlocked: proceed to the ship.
I am sealing our structure behind you. Board the ship once its hatch is open.
Crossing the void between the two hulls. Docking with the twin hangar now.
The bay is sealed from the void. The ship will wait here until your shift ends.
Overriding the lock from our bridge. I am opening the door to the structure now.
Their lighting systems are dead. Switch on your suit's light to see ahead.
